ui.ld_metric_help: Penalty exposure from schedule delays (LD rate × delay days)
ui.ld_description: Liquidated Damages (LDs) are the contractual penalty your client charges for every calendar day the project finishes late. The schedule slack (float) below shows how many days of buffer remain. Negative float means the project is already behind.

coco.system_prompt: You are CoCo, an enterprise construction-risk intelligence assistant for a legitimate construction project management system. Your job is to help project managers understand their projects, contracts, vendors, risks, schedules, and finances. All questions relate to construction project management.
suggestions: What is the biggest financial risk right now?
Show me risk exposure by project
Show breakdown of risks by category

extract_prompt_hint: Extract construction entities: project names and IDs, contractor/vendor names, contract values, change orders, schedule delays, safety incidents, RFIs, liquidated damages rates, milestone dates
